notApplicable.medianInterestCoverage: Interest expense is a bank's cost of funding, not a fixed charge covered out of operating income, so interest coverage does not measure the same thing here.
notApplicable.medianNetDebtToEbitda: Deposits and other funding sit in debt while EBITDA excludes the interest those liabilities earn, so net debt to EBITDA has no comparable meaning.
notApplicable.shareCoverageBelow2: Interest expense is a bank's cost of funding, not a fixed charge covered out of operating income, so interest coverage does not measure the same thing here.
notApplicable.grossMargin: Banks and insurers report no cost of revenue, so the stored gross margin is 1.0 by construction rather than a measure of pricing.
